content.title: Weeknotes: Whiskey In The Jar — Week 44, 2026

content.html:
• 今週って忙しかったけど、やっと終わった！良かった！
  • For two big pieces of work I am doing, my summary is the same: Two steps forward, one half step back and a step to the side. Progress is progress I guess.
  • Cocktails were wonderful and we spoke openly about some personal things I think two years ago I could not. But the one-shot cocktails were the star of the show: One was an old fashioned but somehow grape flavoured?? and another was a peaty pumpkin spice latte. No, really.
  • Kanda okonomiyaki with the boys in blue were very good. Always a pleasure, and fun to compare notes on recent industry happenings.
  • Friday marked an emergency dinner and outing to Nakano, where I fulfilled co-star’s demand for emo songs by singing The Black Parade in the middle of a busy bar. Afterwards a lady sheepishly approached me with a request for a song I’d never heard of. I had to decline.
  • Saturday afternoon I dressed as a time traveller and we went to Ikebukuro to check out the general vibe and to see a bunch of cosplayers. Very impressive cosplay work and my first time being in the middle of a crowd dead-lock. Scary.
  • Time traveler costume? I went dressed as myself from Saturday morning.
  • Went to the Good Design Festival to close the week, and spent hours pottering about looking at lots of cool products with far too many standouts. Don’t worry, no impulse purchases this time. I successfully completed the stamp rally and the お疲れ様でした made it.
